core_obligations: Show K(T) is a full triangulated subcategory of K(O_X) where T is the full subcategory of I-torsion free O_X-modules, and let S be the quasi-isomorphisms of K(T) (proof lines 14285-14294).

Apply the localization criterion to prove S^{-1}K(T) -> D(O_X) is an equivalence: it suffices to find, for every complex G^bullet of O_X-modules, a quasi-isomorphism F^bullet -> G^bullet with F^bullet a complex of I-torsion free modules (proof lines 14295-14305).

Produce that resolution with the help of a K-flat resolution: take F^bullet -> G^bullet quasi-isomorphic with F^bullet consisting of flat modules, and use the third characterization of I-torsion freeness to see that flat modules are I-torsion free (proof lines 14306-14312).

Define L-eta_I by descending eta_f through K(T) -> K(O_X) -> D(O_X), which factors over the localization because eta sends quasi-isomorphisms to quasi-isomorphisms, and record that it is additive and computes eta_I on I-torsion free representatives (proof lines 14314-14328).
proof_roadmap: Identify the torsion-free complexes as a full triangulated subcategory and localize at quasi-isomorphisms.
Prove the localization is all of D(O_X) by resolving arbitrary complexes through flat (hence torsion free) complexes.
Descend the eta construction to the derived category and read off its agreement with eta_I.
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs an additive (not exact) functor L-eta_I on the derived category that agrees with eta_I on complexes of I-torsion free modules, so it must first be shown that the complexes of I-torsion free modules already compute the whole derived category. The proof identifies K(T) inside K(O_X) as a full triangulated subcategory, takes S to be the quasi-isomorphisms, and invokes the localization criterion to prove S^{-1}K(T) -> D(O_X) is an equivalence; to that end it must produce for every complex G^bullet a quasi-isomorphism F^bullet -> G^bullet from a complex of I-torsion free modules, which it obtains from a K-flat resolution together with the observation that flat modules are I-torsion free (proof lines 14285-14319). Only then can L-eta be defined by descent of eta_f along the localization (proof lines 14321-14328). H3: the equivalence of localizations and the descent of the functor are independent research-level steps, not a routine consequence.
